prs.title: docs(workflow): propose WEC V4 bounded lock timing supersession
prs.head: docs/wec1-008-lock-timing-supersede
prs.body:
Propose a complete standalone WEC V4 successor to WEC V3. The behavior delta is limited to remote pre-plan and Owner-resume evidence reads: release the admission lock during collection, then reacquire it and validate exact prerequisites before using the result. Other lock obligations and UNKNOWN / single-writer boundaries are preserved.

The proposal remains proposed with implementation and production authority set to none. Acceptance and predecessor retirement require a later Owner transaction. This PR must not be merged by this delivery task.

Validation: the unchanged 842-line proposal retains SHA-256 77b3e31b772e7502e08dc2544961737df8b0ca5001464f7084f87453310fc5a7 and the recorded independent semantic PASS with 10/10 Contract-to-Acceptance coverage. R4 removes the receipt EOF blank line; staged whitespace check rc0. The receipt and appended stop history record the delivery steps. No source or production changes; product tests were not run.
